categories.whatWorksToday: The shared responsibility model for cloud services is documented, and IT lists suppliers with remote access.

strengths.statement: The shared responsibility model is documented for each critical cloud service.

gapFindings.title: Critical vendor contracts carry no security duties or processing agreements
gapFindings.statement: Contracts with critical vendors lack security duties and processing agreements, so CMC cannot require protection of patient data.

supportingFacts.fact: The HIS vendor contract covers confidentiality only, and due diligence ran at onboarding only.
The PACS vendor contract has no security clauses and no due diligence took place.
No data processing agreement is signed with the HIS, PACS, or web agency vendors.

extent.notChecked: The cloud provider has good terms and other vendors were not profiled

improvementActions.action: Add an owner, review date, and deadline to each duty in the register of CII and PDPA requirements
Review the register every year and after each law or regulator change
Present the Criticality A list to the CIO and CEO for approval and link it to recovery priorities
Approve a risk appetite statement and one risk method
Start a shared risk register that executives review
Add cybersecurity risks to the enterprise risk report presented to the board each quarter
Issue a mandate letter for the Security Manager covering authority, reporting line, and budget, and name an accountable executive
Name a business owner for PACS and Active Directory and record the owner duties
Add security duties to job descriptions and joiner, mover, and leaver steps with HR
Approve the Information Security Policy and communicate it to all staff and vendors
Introduce a policy exception form with risk owner, compensating control, and expiry date
Set up a security steering committee that meets quarterly with a baseline metric set
Add security clauses and a data processing agreement to the HIS and PACS vendor contracts
Require security due diligence before every new critical vendor contract
Replace unattended vendor remote tools with a supervised access method protected by MFA
Rank all vendors by criticality and list the access each one holds
Include critical vendors in incident response planning and contract exit steps
